```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(vegan)
library(pairwiseAdonis)

load(here("Data", "permanova_matrix_clean.Rdata")) # unscaled matrix
load(here("Data", "annotation_col.Rdata"))         # metadata

df_prep <- as.data.frame(permanova_matrix)

# --- 1. Save the sample row names before they get erased ---
sample_labels <- rownames(df_prep)

# Force every column to be numeric
clean_df <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_prep, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))))

# --- 2. Put the sample row names back on the clean data frame ---
rownames(clean_df) <- sample_labels

# Drop any columns that are entirely NA
clean_df <- clean_df[, colSums(is.na(clean_df)) < nrow(clean_df), drop = FALSE]

# Omit any rows with missing values so scale() doesn't fail
clean_df <- na.omit(clean_df)

# --- 3. Finalize and Scale with Labels Intact ---
final_permanova_matrix <- as.matrix(clean_df)

# Z-score scaling (scale() preserves both row and column names on matrices!)
scaled_permanova_matrix <- scale(final_permanova_matrix)

# --- 4. Double check metadata alignment ---
# Ensure your metadata rows exactly match your filtered matrix rows
annotation_col_filtered <- annotation_col[rownames(scaled_permanova_matrix), , drop = FALSE]

# Drop the mismatched NA row from BOTH objects ---
# Identify which rows are valid (not NA) in your filtered metadata
valid_rows <- !is.na(annotation_col_filtered$species)

# Sync both structures simultaneously 
annotation_col_filtered <- annotation_col_filtered[valid_rows, , drop = FALSE]
scaled_permanova_matrix <- scaled_permanova_matrix[valid_rows, , drop = FALSE]

```
